description: Execute a single agent turn for an originator message in core__agent_thread. Submitted exclusively by AgentMessagingService._dispatch_turn after a successful agent_thread_open or agent_send HTTP request — never authored by the model. EDGE action whose result is always bridge-delivered through plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::deliver_result, even when the turn fails: the structured payload carries status='idle'|'interrupted'|'error' and (on failure) error={code, message}. plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::deliver_error is reserved for bridge/platform contract failures and is never produced by run_turn outcomes.
embedding_description: Execute one agent turn for an inter-agent thread. Internal runner submitted by AgentMessagingService. Resolves backend, assembles bounded prompt, invokes GuardedAgentInterface.execute_agent, persists agent or system/error message, returns a structured payload (success or status='error') delivered via bridge_delivery_result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Executes one inter-agent turn against the resolved backend (codex or claude_code).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Turn failures arrive as bridge_delivery_result events whose wrapped payload has status='error' and error.code set. Stable codes: agent_thread_not_found (thread row gone), agent_thread_run_guard (stale/duplicated run_turn against a non-queued thread), agent_thread_transition_failed (status mutation rejected), agent_message_not_found (originator message missing), agent_execution_failed (backend ExecutionResult.error set), agent_messaging_error (catch-all). bridge_delivery_error is reserved for platform-side bridge contract violations and will not surface a turn outcome.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Inspect payload.error.code in the bridge_delivery_result event to dispatch recovery. agent_thread_not_found / agent_thread_run_guard typically mean the originator should reopen the thread. agent_execution_failed surfaces the underlying CLI/SDK message in payload.error.message; retry with adjusted working_directory or prompt is the typical next step. agent_messaging_error is a fallback that warrants investigating the persisted system/error message row in agent_messages.
